name: Australia
summary: Oceanic continent characterized by arid interior rangelands and temperate coastal fringe. Rapidly scaling rooftop solar and utility battery storage amid high export and domestic per capita coal dependence.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 1.24x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); excellent baseline air quality interrupted by bushfire episodes.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; BoM recorded national mean temperature +0.98 °C above historical climatology.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear least-squares warming trend across Australian continental stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 1.0% share of global fossil emissions; large exporter of thermal and metallurgical coal.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: High per capita emissions from historic coal power reliance, transport distances, and resource processing.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Native eucalyptus woodlands and temperate rainforests covering ~1,340,000 km².

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: World-leading rooftop solar penetration; solar provided 16.3% and wind 12.1% of national electricity generation.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 3.4 people/km²; urban population fraction is 86.6%.
